title: Synthesis of sol–gel poly(ethylene glycol) coated foams for the microextraction of multiclass pesticides from apple juice samples
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27256-27268
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01360K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Apostolia Tsiasioti, Natalia Manousi, Abuzar Kabir, Aristidis Anthemidis, Erwin Rosenberg
To ensure food safety and fair-trade practices in fruit juices, a simple and efficient foam-in-syringe solid-phase extraction (FIS-SPE) method was developed and coupled with HPLC-DAD for multiclass pesticide monitoring.
